name: An event related to escape chute/slides (ATA Code:2565)
path: Aircraft/system/component › 2500 Aircraft equipment/furnishing › 2560 Emergency equipment

name: Fire protection system related event (ATA Code:2600)
path: Aircraft/system/component
definition: (ATA Code:2600) An event involving the fixed and portable units and components which detect and indicate fire or smoke and store and distribute fire extinguishing agent to all protected areas of the aircraft.

name: Aircraft flight control related event (ATA Code:2700)
path: Aircraft/system/component
definition: (ATA Code:2700) An event involving the units and components furnishing a means of manually controlling the flight attitude characteristics of the aircraft. Also includes the functioning and maintenance aspects of the flaps, spoilers and other control surfaces, but does not include the structure. Does not include rotorcraft flight controls. Typical parts are hydraulic boost system, controls and mounting brackets.

name: 2750 Trailing edge flap control system (ATA code 2750)
path: Aircraft/system/component › 2700 Aircraft flight control
definition: The system components and parts, except the actuator and position indicator which controls position and movement of wing trailing edge flaps. Typical parts are control valve, switch, flow limiter, cable, torque tube, transmission, jackscrew, bypass valve, limit switch, return spring, buss cable, etc.

name: Leading Edge Slat Control System (ATA 2780)
path: Aircraft/system/component › 2700 Aircraft flight control
definition: The system components and parts except the actuator and position indicating system that controls the position and movement of the wing leading edge devices used for lift augmenting. Typical parts are leading edge flaps, variable opening wing slots, priority valve, switch, cable, pulley, actuator bracket, torque shaft, regulator, etc.

name: Fuel system related event (ATA Code:2800)
path: Aircraft/system/component
definition: (ATA Code:2800) An event involving the units and components storing and delivering fuel to the engine. Includes the integral tank leak detection and sealing. Does not include the structure of integral, tip fuel tanks, fuel cell backing boards, the fuel flow rate sensing, transmitting, or indicating systems.

name: Fuel leak (ATA Code:2801)
path: Aircraft/system/component › 2800 Fuel system
definition: (ATA Code:2801) Fuel leak: fuel escaping from broken/ruptured fuel lines, reservoirs etc

name: Hydraulic system related event (ATA Code:2900)
path: Aircraft/system/component
definition: (ATA Code:2900) An event involving the units and components which furnish hydraulic fluid under pressure to a common point (manifold) for re-distribution to other defined systems.

name: Ice/rain protection system related event (ATA Code:3000)
path: Aircraft/system/component
definition: (ATA Code:3000) An event involving the units and components which provide a means of preventing or disposing of formation of ice and rain on various parts of the aircraft.

name: Indicating/recording systems related event (ATA Code:3100)
path: Aircraft/system/component
definition: (ATA Code:3100) An event involving the pictorial coverage of all instrument panels and controls. Procedural coverage of those systems which give visual or aural warning of conditions in systems which record, store, or compute data from unrelated systems. Includes the system or units which integrate indicating instruments into a central display system not related to any specific system.

name: Data recording related event (ATA Code:3130)
path: Aircraft/system/component › 3100 Indicating/recording systems
definition: (ATA Code:3130) An event involving the unit which continuously records critical flight, aircraft and powerplant system data, e.g. attitude, air speed, altitude or engine power. Includes the system and parts which provide a source of power and inputs, from various sources critical to flight, to flight data recorder. Typical parts are spool rod and magazine.

name: Central warning related event (ATA Code:3150)
path: Aircraft/system/component › 3100 Indicating/recording systems
definition: (ATA Code:3150) An event involving the panels and associated circuitry which warn of potential problems in two or more independent or related systems. Warnings can be either audible or visual. Typical parts are annunciator panel, relay, lamp, PC board, diode and throttle micro switch.

name: 3110 Instrument and control panels related event
path: Aircraft/system/component › 3100 Indicating/recording systems
definition: Events related to all panels fixed or movable with their replaceable components such as instruments, switches, circuit breakers, fuses, etc. Also includes general coverage of instrument panel vibrators and other panel accessories.

name: 3120 Independent Instruments related event
path: Aircraft/system/component › 3100 Indicating/recording systems
definition: Events related to the units which measures time, logs elapsed time of operation, or measures acceleration/deceleration forces. Typical parts are hour meter, pressure switch, line, etc.

name: 3140 Central Computers related events
path: Aircraft/system/component › 3100 Indicating/recording systems
definition: Events related to systems and components used for computing data from a number of different sources without a preponderance of functions in any one system. Includes items such as Digital Core Avionic System (DCAS), stored check list, emergency procedures, company regulations, etc., for call up on a display, integrated instrument systems such as engine, airplane power and central warning indicators when combined into a central display.

name: 3160 Central Display systems related event
path: Aircraft/system/component › 3100 Indicating/recording systems
definition: Events related to systems and components which give visual display of conditions in unrelated systems.

name: 3170 Automatic Data Reporting Systems related events
path: Aircraft/system/component › 3100 Indicating/recording systems
definition: Events related to systems and components used for collating and computing data from unrelated systems and transmitting same automatically. Includes ASDAR systems and components.

name: Landing gear related event (ATA Code:3200)
path: Aircraft/system/component
definition: (ATA Code:3200) An event involving the units and components which furnish a means of supporting and steering the aircraft on the ground or water, and retracting and stowing the landing gear in flight. Includes the functioning and maintenance aspects of the landing gear doors.

name: Main landing gear related event (ATA Code:3210)
path: Aircraft/system/component › 3200 Landing gear
definition: (ATA Code:3210) An event related to the miscellaneous parts of the main landing gear system which cannot be directly associated with a specific main gear code, such as attachment, emergency flotation or strut, axle or truck. Does not include the retraction/extension system or the doors.

name: Main gear partial collapse or retraction
path: Aircraft/system/component › 3200 Landing gear › 3210 Main landing gear
definition: An event involving a collapse or retraction of the aircraft's main landing gear while it was supporting the aircraft.

name: Main gear complete collapse or retraction
path: Aircraft/system/component › 3200 Landing gear › 3210 Main landing gear
definition: An event involving the complete gear collapse or retraction while it was supporting the aircraft.

name: Nose/tail landing gear related event (ATA Code:3220)
path: Aircraft/system/component › 3200 Landing gear
definition: (ATA Code:3220) An event related to the miscellaneous parts of the nose or tail gear system which cannot be directly associated with a specific nose/tail gear code such as attachment, struts or axles. Does not include extension/retraction mechanism, steering/dampening system or doors.

name: Nose gear collapsed/retracted
path: Aircraft/system/component › 3200 Landing gear › 3220 Nose/tail landing gear
definition: An event involving the collapse or retraction of the aircraft's nose gear while it was supporting the aircraft.

name: Wheels and brakes related event (ATA Code:3240)
path: Aircraft/system/component › 3200 Landing gear
definition: (ATA Code:3240) An event related to the aircraft's wheels and brakes. Including the brake system miscellaneous parts other than the brake assembly, master cylinder, power valve, anti-skid system, the pressure source and associated system for emergency brake actuation and brake anti-ice system. Typical parts are line, hose, fitting, park brake valve and gauge.

name: Tyres related event (ATA Code:3244)
path: Aircraft/system/component › 3200 Landing gear
definition: (ATA Code:3244) An event related to tyre defects and failures.

name: Brakes related event (ATA Code:3242)
path: Aircraft/system/component › 3200 Landing gear
definition: (ATA Code:3242) An event involving the parts of the brake unit mounted at the wheels only. Typical parts are disc, cylinder, lining, seal, rotor and housing.

name: Parking brake related event
path: Aircraft/system/component › 3200 Landing gear › 3242 Brakes
definition: An event involving the aircraft's parking brake.

name: Emergency brake related event
path: Aircraft/system/component › 3200 Landing gear › 3242 Brakes
definition: An event involving the aircraft's emergency brake.

name: Anti-skid system related event (ATA Code:3241)
path: Aircraft/system/component › 3200 Landing gear
definition: (ATA Code:3241) An event involving the system units and parts which automatically control brake pressure during landing roll to prevent tyre skidding. Typical parts are transducer, control box and valve.

name: Landing gear steering related event (ATA Code:3250)
path: Aircraft/system/component › 3200 Landing gear
definition: (ATA Code:3250) An event involving the miscellaneous system parts other than the actuator which provide for aircraft directional control on the ground. Includes main gear steering systems. Does not include wheel braking systems. Typical parts are, cable, rod end, collar, line, valve and accumulator.

name: Landing gear position and warning system related event (ATA Code:3260)
path: Aircraft/system/component › 3200 Landing gear
definition: (ATA Code:3260) An event involving the system parts which provide indication and warning of the landing gear position. Includes gear safety switches which prevent inadvertent actuation such as squat or air/ground sensor. Typical parts are relay, switch bracket, lamp, horn, up lock switch, down lock switch and in transit switch.

name: Auxiliary landing gear related event (ATA Code:3270)
path: Aircraft/system/component › 3200 Landing gear
definition: (ATA Code:3270) An event involving the devices such as tail skids on tricycle gear aircraft used to stabilize the aircraft on the ground and to prevent ground contact damage. This code is also used for supplementary wheels on rotorcraft, skids for ground handling but not for skids or amphibian/seaplane floats, hull or associated retractable landing gear. Does not include auxiliary or emergency landing gear extension systems.

name: Other gear collapsed/retracted
path: Aircraft/system/component › 3200 Landing gear › 3270 Auxiliary landing gear
definition: An event involving the collapse or retraction of gear other than the nose, tail or main gear, while it is supporting the weight of the aircraft.

name: Aircraft lighting related event (ATA Code:3300)
path: Aircraft/system/component
definition: (ATA Code:3300) An event involving the units and components which provide for external and internal illumination. Includes light fixtures, switches and wiring. Does not include warning lights for individual systems.

name: Navigation systems related event (ATA Code:3400)
path: Aircraft/system/component
definition: (ATA Code:3400) An event involving the units and components which provide aircraft navigational information.

name: 3410 Flight Environment Data systems realeted event
path: Aircraft/system/component › 3400 Navigation systems
definition: Events related to that portion of the system which senses environmental conditions and uses the data to influence navigation. Includes such items as Central Air Data Computers, pitot/static systems, air temperature, rate-of-climb, airspeed, high speed warning, altitude, altitude reporting, altimeter correction system, air disturbance detection system, etc.

name: Airspeed/Mach indicating system related event (ATA Code:3414)
path: Aircraft/system/component › 3400 Navigation systems › 3410 Flight Environment Data
definition: (ATA Code:3414) An event involving the instrument which measures and indicates speed of the aircraft.

name: Altitude system related event (ATA Code:3416)
path: Aircraft/system/component › 3400 Navigation systems › 3410 Flight Environment Data
definition: (ATA Code:3416) An event involving the altimeters and barometric encoders used to measure and indicate altitude. Also includes the unit which senses and alerts to a change in a pre-selected altitude. Does not include the ground proximity systems. Typical parts are dial, case, pointer and spring.

name: Flight management system related event (ATA Code:3418)
path: Aircraft/system/component › 3400 Navigation systems › 3410 Flight Environment Data
definition: (ATA Code:3418) An event involving the system which combines navigational data to compute or manage the aircraft's geographical position or theoretical flight path. Typical parts are course computers, flight management computers, performance data computers, associated control display units and warning annunciators.

name: 3420 Attitude and direction data system related event (ATA Code:3420)
path: Aircraft/system/component › 3400 Navigation systems
definition: (ATA Code:3420) An event involving the system components and parts which use magnetic, gyroscopic, and inertia forces to indicate an aircraft attitude and direction. Includes such items as the inertial reference system (IRS).

name: Landing and taxi aids related event (ATA Code:3430)
path: Aircraft/system/component › 3400 Navigation systems
definition: (ATA Code:3430) An event involving the system providing guidance during approach, landing and taxiing. Includes such items as, ILS, paravisual director, ground guidance systems and markers.

name: Independent position determining system related event (ATA Code:3440)
path: Aircraft/system/component › 3400 Navigation systems
definition: (ATA Code:3440) An event involving the system which provides information to determine the aircraft's position and is primarily independent of ground installations. Typical parts are star tracker and sextants/octants.

name: Ground proximity warning system related event (ATA Code:3444)
path: Aircraft/system/component › 3400 Navigation systems › 3440 Independent position system
definition: (ATA Code:3444) An event involving the system which detects and alerts flight crew to potential terrain hazards. Includes the antenna which transmits and receives an electronic signal for the radio altimeter equipment used for terrain-to-aircraft distance. Also includes the component which interprets a radio signal reflected back to a receiver to determine distance from the nearest terrain; and the component which process the warning computer input signals from various sources in order to determ

name: Ground proximity warning system nuisance alarm
path: Aircraft/system/component › 3400 Navigation systems › 3440 Independent position system › 3444 Ground proximity warning
definition: An event involving nuisance warnings by the aircraft's ground proximity warning system.

name: Other ground proximity warning system related event
path: Aircraft/system/component › 3400 Navigation systems › 3440 Independent position system › 3444 Ground proximity warning
definition: An event involving the aircraft's ground proximity warning system other than a nuisance warning.

name: Airborne collision avoidance system/traffic alert and collision avoidance system related
path: Aircraft/system/component › 3400 Navigation systems › 3440 Independent position system
definition: event (ATA Code:3445) (3445 ACAS/TCAS) (ATA Code:3445) An event involving the system which provides information to determine aircraft position and is primarily independent of ground installations (i.e., traffic alert and collision avoidance system TCAS). Typical parts are collision avoidance monitoring units.

name: ACAS/TCAS nuisance alarm
path: Aircraft/system/component › 3400 Navigation systems › 3440 Independent position system › Airborne collision avoidance system/traffic alert and collision avoidance system related
definition: An event involving a nuisance alarm from the aircraft's airborne collision avoidance system or traffic alert and collision avoidance system.

name: 3450 Dependent Position Determining System related event
path: Aircraft/system/component › 3400 Navigation systems
definition: Events related to that portion of the system which provides information to determine position and is mainly dependent on ground installations or orbital satellites. Includes items such as DME, transponders, radio compass, LORAN, VOR, ADF, OMEGA, GLOBAL POSITIONING, etc.

name: Flight management system related event (ATA Code:3460)
path: Aircraft/system/component › 3400 Navigation systems
definition: An event involving the system which combines navigational data to compute or manage the aircraft's geographical position or theoretical flight path. Typical parts are course computers, flight management computers, performance data computers, associated control display units and warning annunciators.

name: Oxygen system related event (ATA Code:3500)
path: Aircraft/system/component
definition: (ATA Code:3500) An event involving the units and components which store, regulate and deliver breathing oxygen to the passengers and crew. Typical parts are bottles, relief valves, shut-off valves, outlets, regulators, masks and walk-around bottles.

name: Pneumatic system related event (ATA Code:3600)
path: Aircraft/system/component
definition: (ATA Code:3600) An event involving the units and components which deliver large volumes of compressed air from a power source to connecting points for other systems such as air conditioning, pressurization and de-icing.

name: Vacuum system related event (ATA Code:3700)
path: Aircraft/system/component
definition: (ATA Code:3700) An event involving the units and components used to generate, deliver and regulate negative air pressure.

name: Drinkable/waste water system related event (ATA Code:3800)
path: Aircraft/system/component
definition: (ATA Code:3800) An event involving the fixed units and components which store and deliver fresh water. Also includes those fixed components which store and furnish a means of removal of water and waste.

name: 4100 Water ballast system
path: Aircraft/system/component
definition: Event related to units and components provided for the storage, balancing, control, filling, discharge, and dumping of water ballast.

name: 4200 Integrated modular avionics related event
path: Aircraft/system/component
definition: Event related to computing devices that can host software applications for system functions that had traditionally been implemented in dedicated hardware. The actual system functions are covered in their respective ATA chapters.

name: 4400 Cabin systems related event
path: Aircraft/system/component
definition: Event related to units and components which furnish a means of entertaining the passengers and providing communication within the aircraft and between the aircraft cabin and ground stations. Includes voice, data, music and video transmissions. Does not include SATCOM, HF, VHF, UHF and all transmitting/receiving equipment, antennas, etc., which are covered in Chapter 23 or Chapter 46.

name: 4500 Central Maintenance Computer
path: Aircraft/system/component
definition: Event related to units, components and associated system which interfaces with multiple aircraft systems. Contains checkout and fault isolation procedures using a central computer complex and/or standard fault isolation procedures to locate a single system or component malfunction.

name: 4600 Information systems
path: Aircraft/system/component
definition: Event related to units and components which furnish a means of storing, updating, and retrieving digital information traditionally provided on paper, microfilm, or microfiche. Includes units that are dedicated to the information storage and retrieval function such as the Electronic Library mass storage and controller. Does not include units or components installed for other uses and shared with other systems, such as flight deck printer or general use display.

name: 4700 Inert gas system related event
path: Aircraft/system/component
definition: Event relted to units and components used to generate, store, deliver and regulate inert gas. Includes regulators, lines, manifolds, etc.

name: Auxiliary power unit related event (ATA Code:4900)
path: Aircraft/system/component
definition: (ATA Code:4900) An event involving the airborne auxiliary power units (APU) installed on aircraft for the purpose of generating and supplying a single type or combination of auxiliary electric, hydraulic, pneumatic or other power. Does not include generators, alternators, hydraulic pumps or their connecting systems which supply and deliver power to their respective aircraft systems.

name: 5000 Cargo and accessory compartments related events
path: Aircraft/system/component
definition: Those compartments for storage of cargo and various components and accessories. Includes those systems used to load/unload cargo and other cargo related systems. Does not include aircraft structure which is in Capter 53

name: 5040 not used
path: Aircraft/system/component › 5000 Cargo and accessory compartments

name: 5010 Cargo Compartments related events
path: Aircraft/system/component › 5000 Cargo and accessory compartments
definition: Event related to compartments for the storage of cargo

name: Cargo related event
path: Aircraft/system/component › 5000 Cargo and accessory compartments › 5010 Cargo Compartments
definition: An event involving the aircraft's cargo.

name: Cargo leak
path: Aircraft/system/component › 5000 Cargo and accessory compartments › 5010 Cargo Compartments › 5019 Cargo related
definition: An event involving a leak from the aircraft's cargo other than a radiation leak.

name: Cargo shifted
path: Aircraft/system/component › 5000 Cargo and accessory compartments › 5010 Cargo Compartments › 5019 Cargo related
definition: An event involving a shift of the aircraft's cargo after the aircraft was loaded.

name: Cargo smoke/fumes/fire
path: Aircraft/system/component › 5000 Cargo and accessory compartments › 5010 Cargo Compartments › 5019 Cargo related
definition: An event involving smoke, fumes or fire in the aircraft's cargo compartment.

name: Cargo radiation leak
path: Aircraft/system/component › 5000 Cargo and accessory compartments › 5010 Cargo Compartments › 5019 Cargo related
definition: An event involving a leak of radioactive material, or radiation, from the aircraft's cargo.

name: Cargo/sling load dropped
path: Aircraft/system/component › 5000 Cargo and accessory compartments › 5010 Cargo Compartments › 5019 Cargo related
definition: Cargo/sling load dropped: to used when the dropping of the load was the rwsult of any failure. Intentional dropping of the sling load is covered under 'consequential events'

name: 5020 Cargo Loading Systems related event
path: Aircraft/system/component › 5000 Cargo and accessory compartments
definition: Events related to systems which have components which are or can be mounted on the aircraft and used to load/unload, restrain, guide or service cargo. Includes drive systems, rollers, latches, restraint nets etc.

name: 5030 Cargo Related Systems related events
path: Aircraft/system/component › 5000 Cargo and accessory compartments
definition: Events related to systems which are related to loading/unloading of cargo. Includes aircraft levelling, loader alignment systems etc. Does not include Cargo Loading Systems.

name: 5050 Accessory Compartments related event
path: Aircraft/system/component › 5000 Cargo and accessory compartments
definition: Event related to compartments used for the housing of various components and accessories. Includes wheel wells, tail- hydraulic-electrical/electronic equipment racks, main battery structure etc.

name: 5060 Insulation
path: Aircraft/system/component › 5000 Cargo and accessory compartments
definition: Events related to insulation blankets which are used for heat and sound insulation. Includes cargo compartments and accessory compartments, insulation, etc.

name: Standard practices and structures (ATA Code:5100)
path: Aircraft/system/component
definition: (ATA Code:5100) An event involving the standard practices and general procedures for typical repairs applicable to the aircraft's airframe or structure.

name: Airframe structure - general related event (ATA Code:5101)
path: Aircraft/system/component › 5100 Standard practices and structures
definition: (ATA Code:5101) An event involving aircraft structural problems of a general nature which affects two or more areas. Includes reports of lightning strikes which cannot be associated with a specific code.

name: Aircraft's doors related event (ATA Code:5200)
path: Aircraft/system/component
definition: (ATA Code:5200) An event involving any of the removable units used for entrance or exit and for enclosing other structure contained within the fuselage. Includes passenger and crew doors, cargo doors and emergency exits. Electrical and hydraulic systems associated with door control are included as appropriate.

name: Doors - general related event (ATA Code:5201)
path: Aircraft/system/component › 5200 Aircraft's doors
definition: (ATA Code:5201) An event involving any of the aircraft's doors in general.

name: Door opening
path: Aircraft/system/component › 5200 Aircraft's doors › 5201 Doors - general
definition: An event involving the inadvertent or intentional opening of any of the aircraft's doors.

name: Door separation
path: Aircraft/system/component › 5200 Aircraft's doors › 5201 Doors - general
definition: An event involving the separation of any of the aircraft's doors.

name: Door warning system related event
path: Aircraft/system/component › 5200 Aircraft's doors › 5201 Doors - general
definition: An event involving the aircraft's door warning system.

name: Aircraft's fuselage structure related event (ATA Code:5300)
path: Aircraft/system/component
definition: (ATA Code:5300) An event involving the structural units and associated components and members which make up the compartments for crew, passengers, equipment, cargo and the structure of the envelope and gondola of airships.

name: Airframe failure - other than general breakup (ATA Code:5301)
path: Aircraft/system/component › 5300 Aircraft's fuselage structure
definition: (ATA Code:5301) An event involving a failure of the aircraft's airframe or structure other than a general disintegration or break-up.

name: Airframe general disintegration or break-up (ATA Code:5302)
path: Aircraft/system/component › 5300 Aircraft's fuselage structure
definition: (ATA Code:5302) An event involving a general disintegration or break-up of the aircraft's airframe or structure.

name: Aircraft engine nacelle or pylon structure related event (ATA Code:5400)
path: Aircraft/system/component
definition: (ATA Code:5400) An event involving the structural units and associated components and members which furnish a means of mounting and housing the power plant or rotor assembly. Includes the structure of power plant cowling inclusive of the structural portion of the inlet whether or not integral with the aircraft. Structural portions of the exhaust system are excluded where they are not integral with the airframe.

name: Aircraft empennage stucture related event (ATA Code:5500)
path: Aircraft/system/component
definition: (ATA Code:5500) An event involving the horizontal and vertical stabilizers including the structure of the elevator and rudder. This code is also used for reports that pertain to flying wires.

name: 5510 Horizontal Stabilizer/Canard Structure related event
path: Aircraft/system/component › 5500 Aircraft empennage structure
definition: Event related to the horizontal airfoil of the tail or nose section to which the elevator is attached. Includes items such as spars, ribs, stringers, skins, access covers, tips, attach/attached fittings, etc.

name: Aircraft elevator related event (ATA Code:5520)
path: Aircraft/system/component › 5500 Aircraft empennage structure
definition: (ATA Code:5520) An event involving the structural aspects of the movable aerofoil hinged to the horizontal stabilizer for longitudinal control. Includes the 'ruddervator' on V-tail aircraft and balance weights. Does not include the stabilator structure.

name: 5530 Vertical Stabilizer related event
path: Aircraft/system/component › 5500 Aircraft empennage structure
definition: Event related to the vertical airfoil to which the rudder is attached. Includes items such as spars, ribs, stringers, skins, access covers, tips, attach/attached fittings, etc.

name: Aircraft rudder related event (ATA Code:5540)
path: Aircraft/system/component › 5500 Aircraft empennage structure
definition: (ATA Code:5540) An event involving the structural aspects of the vertical aerofoil hinged to the vertical stabilizer. Does not include the actuators, actuator mechanism or mounting. Typical parts are hinge, hinge fittings, bearing, bolt and miscellaneous structure.

name: Aircraft windows/windshields related event (ATA Code:5600)
path: Aircraft/system/component
definition: (ATA Code:5600) An event involving the fuselage and crew compartment windows inclusive of windshields.

name: Aircraft's windows in general related event (ATA Code:5601)
path: Aircraft/system/component › 5600 Aircraft windows/windshields
definition: (ATA Code:5601) An event involving the aircraft's windows in general.

name: Window separation in flight
path: Aircraft/system/component › 5600 Aircraft windows/windshields › 5601 Aircraft's windows in general
definition: An event involving the separation in flight of an aircraft window.

name: 5610 Flight compartment window
path: Aircraft/system/component › 5600 Aircraft windows/windshields
definition: 5610 Flight compartment window: includes cockpit windows, cockpit overhead canopies, observation windows, and windshield panels in the flight compartment. Includes attachment and sliding feature of sliding windows. For cockpit windows including the breakage of electrically heated windshield panels regardless of cause.

name: Aircraft wing structure related event (ATA Code:5700)
path: Aircraft/system/component
definition: (ATA Code:5700) An event involving the centre wing and outer wing structural units and associated components and members which support the aircraft in flight. This code should be used for general reports of the primary wing structure. Control surfaces (on the wing) related event (ATA Code:5750) (5750 Control surfaces)                                    1575000   * (ATA Code:5750) An event involving the control surfaces which are attached to the wing.

name: 5740 Wing Leading Edge and Leading Edge Devices
path: Aircraft/system/component › 5700 Aircraft wing structure
definition: Event related to skins and structure of the wing leading edge and removable leading edge airfoils such as flaps, slats, attach/attached fittings, etc.

name: 5750 Wing Trailing Edge / Trailing Edge Devices
path: Aircraft/system/component › 5700 Aircraft wing structure
definition: Event related to skins and structure of the wing and trailing edge and removable edge airfoils such as flaps and attach/attached fittings

name: 6000 STANDARD PRACTICES - PROPELLER/ROTOR
path: Aircraft/system/component
definition: (ATA Code 6000) STANDARD PRACTICES - PROPELLER/ROTOR

name: Propellers related event (ATA Code:6100)
path: Aircraft/system/component
definition: (ATA Code:6100) An event involving the complete mechanical or electrical propeller, governor, alternators, pumps, motors those units and components external to or integral with the engine used to control the propeller blade angle. Includes the propulsor duct assemblies, aerodynamic fairing of mechanical components, stators and vectoring systems.

name: Aircraft's propellers related event (ATA Code:6101)
path: Aircraft/system/component › 6100 Propellers generally
definition: (ATA Code:6101) An event involving any of the aircraft's propellers in general.

name: Propeller over-speed
path: Aircraft/system/component › 6100 Propellers generally › 6101 Aircraft propellers - general
definition: An event involving a propeller over-speed.

name: Propeller separation
path: Aircraft/system/component › 6100 Propellers generally › 6101 Aircraft propellers - general
definition: An event involving the separation of a propeller from its engine.

name: Propeller control
path: Aircraft/system/component › 6100 Propellers generally › 6101 Aircraft propellers - general
definition: An event related to the control of a propeller.

name: Rotorcraft main rotor systems related event (ATA Code:6200)
path: Aircraft/system/component
definition: (ATA Code:6200) An event involving the rotorcraft main rotor systems. Main rotor: the rotor that supplies the principal lift to a rotorcraft.

name: Helicopter's main rotor in general related event (ATA Code:6201)
path: Aircraft/system/component › 6200 Rotorcraft main rotor system
definition: (ATA Code:6201) An event involving a helicopter's main rotor in general. Main rotor: the rotor that supplies the principal lift to a rotorcraft.

name: Main rotor blade flapping
path: Aircraft/system/component › 6200 Rotorcraft main rotor system › 6201 Main rotor - general
definition: An event involving flapping of the helicopter's main rotor blades.

name: Main rotor drive system related event (ATA Code:6300)
path: Aircraft/system/component
definition: (ATA Code:6300) An event involving the main rotor drive system.

name: Main rotor drive shaft (ATA Code:6301)
path: Aircraft/system/component › 6300 Main rotor drive system
definition: (ATA Code:6301) An event involving the helicopter's main rotor drive shaft.

name: Main rotor transmission/gearbox (ATA Code:6320)
path: Aircraft/system/component › 6300 Main rotor drive system

definition: Cargo dumped: e.g. dumping the cargo of an agricultural aircraft as a consequence of a preceding event.

name: Change aircraft
path: Consequential events
definition: A change of aircraft as the consequence of previous events.

name: Clearance cancelled
path: Consequential events
definition: A clearance was cancelled, e.g. as the consequence of a runway incursion.

name: Declared emergency
path: Consequential events
definition: A declared emergency as the consequence of previous events.

name: Declared emergency - Distress (Mayday)
path: Consequential events › Declared emergency
definition: Declared emergency (ICAO Doc 4444) Distress - MAYDAY MAYDAY MAYDAY

name: Declared emergency - Urgency (PAN call)
path: Consequential events › Declared emergency
definition: Declared emergency (ICAO Doc 4444) Urgency - PAN PAN PAN

name: Ditching - forced landing on water
path: Consequential events
definition: A ditching, an unavoidable controlled emergency landing on water as the consequence of previous events.

name: Diversion of an aircraft from the intended destination
path: Consequential events
definition: Diversion: the diversion from the intended destination to another one. Note: Diverting to the aerodrome of departure is to be coded 'aircraft returned'.

name: Diversion due to operational decision
path: Consequential events › Diversion
definition: An event involving a diversion by an aircraft due to an operational decision.

name: Diversion due to technical reasons
path: Consequential events › Diversion
definition: An event involving a diversion by an aircraft due to technical reasons.

name: Diversion due to weather conditions
path: Consequential events › Diversion
definition: An event involving a diversion by an aircraft due to weather conditions.

name: diversion - due to other reasons
path: Consequential events › Diversion
definition: An event involving a diversion by an aircraft due to reasons other than those listed above.

name: Emergency autorotation (helicopter) (Emergency autorotation (helicopter))
path: Consequential events
definition: An emergency autorotation (helicopter) as the consequence of previous events.

name: Emergency cancelled
path: Consequential events
definition: An emergency cancelled as the consequence of previous events.

name: Emergency descent
path: Consequential events
definition: An emergency descent as the consequence of previous events. The events mark the decision to carry out the emergency descent. 'Emergency descent' as a sub phase indicates the phase of flight of the aircraft while implementing such a decision.

name: Engine shutdown/flameout
path: Consequential events
definition: An Engine shutdown/flameout as the consequence of previous events.

name: Engine shutdown - precautionary (soft) (Engine shutdown - precautionary (soft))
path: Consequential events › Engine shutdown/flameout
definition: An Engine shutdown (soft) as the consequence of previous events.

name: Engine shutdown (hard) (Engine shutdown (hard))
path: Consequential events › Engine shutdown/flameout
definition: An Engine shutdown (hard) as the consequence of previous events.

name: Evacuation
path: Consequential events
definition: Evacuation: Evacuation means the leaving of the aircraft through approved exits and using approved means following the aircraft emergency evacuation procedure. Escape from the wreckage through breaks in the fuselage is not what is meant by 'evacuation'. Unauthorized leaving the aircraft resulting from panic of passengers is also included here.

name: Evasive manoeuvre
path: Consequential events
definition: Evasive manoeuvre: a manoeuvre carried out be the crew in order to avoid an aircraft / vehicle / obstacle as the consequence of having it observed or being warned of its presence.

name: External load dropped/jettisoned (intentional)
path: Consequential events
definition: The intentional dropping of an external load of a fixed wing aircraft triggered by a preceding event. For helicopters, see events related to helicopter - external load.

name: The landing was executed without flaps/slats
path: Consequential events
definition: The landing was executed without flaps/slats being used. This usually results in higher speeds.

name: Flight cancellation
path: Consequential events
definition: A flight cancellation as the consequence of previous events.

name: Flight delay
path: Consequential events
definition: The flight was delayed as the consequence of a preceding event.

name: Fly-past inspection
path: Consequential events
definition: Fly-past inspection: the aircraft is flying over an observation point (e.g. tower) to permit ground staff to inspect the aircraft. Often used to determine whether the landing gear has been properly extended.

name: Forced landing
path: Consequential events
definition: Forced landing. Unavoidable landing. A forced landing as the consequence of previous events. Note: forced landing is to be used when the aircraft is landed on land. Use 'Ditching' for forced landings on water.

name: Fuel burn off
path: Consequential events
definition: Intentional holding to consume fuel before landing. Usually done in order to prevent overweight landing or to reduce fire hazards.

name: Fuel dumping
path: Consequential events
definition: Fuel dumping

name: Gravity Gear Extension
path: Consequential events
definition: Gravity Gear Extension

name: Handling check
path: Consequential events
definition: Handling check: a check by the crew to determine whether there is any abnormality in handling the aircraft, e.g. after an unusual noise has been heard.

name: Missed approach
path: Consequential events
definition: A missed approach as the consequence of previous events. A missed approach is a segment of an instrument approach procedure that is accomplished if the pilot is unable to successfully complete the approach procedure. A successful approach is accomplished when the pilot can get the airport/runway in sight, but not necessarily to a landing.

name: Aircraft nosed down/overturned
path: Consequential events › Missed approach
definition: An event involving an aircraft which nosed down or overturned.

name: Overweight landing
path: Consequential events › Missed approach
definition: Overweight landing - a landing in which the maximum permissible landing weight was exceeded.

name: Precautionary descent
path: Consequential events › Missed approach
definition: A precautionary descent as the consequence of previous events.

name: Precautionary landing
path: Consequential events › Missed approach
definition: A precautionary landing as the consequence of previous events. A landing necessitated by apparent impending failure of engines, systems, or components which makes continued flight inadvisable.

name: Rejected landing
path: Consequential events › Missed approach
definition: A rejected landing as the consequence of previous events. A rejected landing is an event that occurs when the pilot has the runway in sight and is in a position to land, but is unable to complete the landing. Reasons for rejected landing can be something on the runway, high winds/microburst, mechanical issue (the landing gear does not come down), etc.

name: Rejected take-off
path: Consequential events › Missed approach
definition: A rejected take-off as the consequence of previous events.

name: High speed rejected take-off (at and above V1)
path: Consequential events › Missed approach › Rejected take-off
definition: High speed rejected take-off - a take-off rejected at a speed at or above V1.

name: Low speed rejected take-off (below V1)
path: Consequential events › Missed approach › Rejected take-off
definition: A take-off rejected at a speed below V1.

name: Rotation - delayed
path: Consequential events › Missed approach
definition: Delayed rotation, e.g. in order to avoid another aircraft

name: Rotation - early
path: Consequential events › Missed approach
definition: Rotation - early, e.g. to avoid another vehicle/aircraft in a runway incursion

name: Uncommanded movement of the aircraft resulting from some previous action, e.g. an event related to an
path: Consequential events › Missed approach
definition: engine start etc. (Uncommanded movement of the aircraft) The aircraft moved when there was no intent of it to be moving. This should capture cases where after a manual engine start, the aircraft starts to run away from its pilot, but also those cases where , e.g. due to vibrations, a helicopter is moving 'on its own'. Could also be used for aircraft 'jumping the chocks'

name: Near tail tipping
path: Consequential events › Missed approach › Uncommanded movement of the aircraft resulting from some previous action, e.g. an event related to an

name: Tail tipping
path: Consequential events › Missed approach › Uncommanded movement of the aircraft resulting from some previous action, e.g. an event related to an

name: Events related to maintenance and repair of the aircraft
definition: Events related to maintenance and repair of the aircraft

name: Defect/malfunction found resulting from mandatory action
path: Aircraft maintenance and Repair
definition: Any failure, malfunction or defect of any system or equipment, or damage or deterioration thereof found as a result of compliance with an airworthiness directive or other mandatory instruction issued by a regulatory authority

name: Defect/malfunction found resulting from mandatory action– first
path: Aircraft maintenance and Repair › Defect/malfunction found resulting from mandatory action
definition: Any failure, malfunction or defect of any system or equipment, or damage or deterioration thereof found as a result of compliance with an airworthiness directive or other mandatory instruction issued by a regulatory authority when it is detected for the first time by the reporting organisation implementing compliance

name: Defect/malfunction found resulting from mandatory action- subsequent
path: Aircraft maintenance and Repair › Defect/malfunction found resulting from mandatory action
definition: Any failure, malfunction or defect of any system or equipment, or damage or deterioration thereof found as a result of compliance with an airworthiness directive or other mandatory instruction issued by a regulatory authority when it is detected on any subsequent compliance, it exceeds the permissible limits quoted in the instruction and/or published repair/rectification procedures are not available

name: Early defect in a life-controlled part
path: Aircraft maintenance and Repair
definition: Any defect in a life-controlled part causing retirement before completion of its full life

name: Failure of emergency system or equipment
path: Aircraft maintenance and Repair
definition: Failure of any emergency system or equipment, including all exit doors and lighting, to perform satisfactorily, including when being used for maintenance or test purposes

name: Hot bleed air leak
path: Aircraft maintenance and Repair
definition: Hot bleed air leak resulting in structural damage

name: Incorrect assembly of parts or components
path: Aircraft maintenance and Repair
definition: Incorrect assembly of parts or components of the aircraft found during an inspection or test procedure not intended for that specific purpose

name: Misleading, incorrect or insufficient maintenance data
path: Aircraft maintenance and Repair
definition: Misleading, incorrect or insufficient maintenance data or procedures that could lead to maintenance errors.

name: Non-compliance - maintenance procedures
path: Aircraft maintenance and Repair
definition: Non-compliance or significant errors in compliance with required maintenance procedures

name: Failure, malfunction or defect of ground equipment used for testing
path: Aircraft maintenance and Repair
definition: Any failure, malfunction or defect of ground equipment used for testing or checking of aircraft systems and equipment when the required routine inspection and test procedures did not clearly iden¬tify the problem, where this results in a hazardous situation

name: Structural damage or deterioration
path: Aircraft maintenance and Repair
definition: Any damage or deterioration (e.g. fractures, cracks, corrosion, delamination, disbonding etc.) resulting from any cause (e.g. as flutter, loss of stiffness or structural failure.

name: Structural damage or deterioration to primary structure
path: Aircraft maintenance and Repair › Structural damage or deterioration
definition: Structural damage or deterioration of a primary structure or a PSE (as defined in the manufacturers' Repair Manual) where such damage or dete¬rioration exceeds allowable limits specified in the Repair Manual and requires a repair or complete or partial replacement

name: Structural damage or deterioration to secondary structure
path: Aircraft maintenance and Repair › Structural damage or deterioration
definition: Structural damage or deterioration to a secondary structure which consequently has or may have endangered the aircraft

name: Structural damage or deterioration - engine
path: Aircraft maintenance and Repair › Structural damage or deterioration
definition: Structural damage or deterioration - engine

name: Structural damage or deterioration - propeller
path: Aircraft maintenance and Repair › Structural damage or deterioration
definition: Structural damage or deterioration - propeller

name: Structural damage or deterioration - rotorcraft rotor system
path: Aircraft maintenance and Repair › Structural damage or deterioration
definition: Structural damage or deterioration - rotorcraft rotor system

name: Suspect parts
path: Aircraft maintenance and Repair
definition: Products, parts, appliances and materials of unknown or suspect origin

name: Bogus parts
path: Aircraft maintenance and Repair › Suspect parts
definition: Products, parts, appliances and materials of known suspect origin

name: Events related to the non-compliance with regulations
definition: Events related to the non-compliance with regulations

name: Aircraft related regulatory event/issue
path: Regulatory issues / events
definition: Aircraft related regulatory event/issue

name: Aircraft not airworthy
path: Regulatory issues / events › Aircraft related regulatory event/issue
definition: Aircraft not airworthy

name: Aircraft not airworthy - airworthiness directive not implemented (Airworthiness directive (AD) not implemented)
path: Regulatory issues / events › Aircraft related regulatory event/issue › Aircraft not airworthy
definition: Aircraft not airworthy - airworthiness directive not implemented

name: The aircraft was not equipped or certified for the type of approach flown
path: Regulatory issues / events › Aircraft related regulatory event/issue
definition: The aircraft was not equipped or certified for the type of approach flown

name: Aircraft was not equipped for the type of operation undertaken.
path: Regulatory issues / events › Aircraft related regulatory event/issue
definition: Aircraft was not equipped for the type of operation undertaken, e.g. missing equipment on board such as survival gear required for the particular operation.

name: Aircraft not RVSM (Reduced Vertical Separation Minimum) equipped while being operated in
path: Regulatory issues / events › Aircraft related regulatory event/issue
definition: RVSM airspace (Aircraft not RVSM equipped) Aircraft not RVSM equipped while being operated in RVSM airspace. RVSM: Reduced Vertical Separation Minimum of 1.000 ft (300 m.)

name: Aircraft operating time / maintenance interval exceeded
path: Regulatory issues / events › Aircraft related regulatory event/issue
definition: Aircraft operating time / maintenance interval exceeded

name: Invalid / no permit to fly: a permit to fly was required for the flight undertaken but it was not
path: Regulatory issues / events › Aircraft related regulatory event/issue
definition: obtained or not valid (Invalid / no permit to fly) Invalid / no permit to fly: a permit to fly was required for the flight undertaken but it was not obtained or not valid

name: Landing with a fuel reserve less than required by regulation
path: Regulatory issues / events › Aircraft related regulatory event/issue

name: Operation of the aircraft in violation of the MEL
path: Regulatory issues / events › Aircraft related regulatory event/issue
definition: Operation of the aircraft in violation of the MEL

name: Duty time related
path: Regulatory issues / events › Aircraft related regulatory event/issue
definition: Duty time related: an event related to the duty time of personnel

name: Duty time exceeded
path: Regulatory issues / events › Aircraft related regulatory event/issue › Duty time related
definition: The exceedance of the duty time by a person

name: Operation in violation of an aerodrome curfew
path: Regulatory issues / events › Aircraft related regulatory event/issue
definition: Operation in violation of aerodrome curfew: the aircraft was taking off too early or arrived too late at an aerodrome covered by a curfew.

name: Operation in violation of license
path: Regulatory issues / events › Aircraft related regulatory event/issue
definition: Operation with an invalid license or carrying out an operation not covered by the license

name: Air operator certificate (AOC) invalid (Air operator certificate (AOC) invalid)
path: Regulatory issues / events › Aircraft related regulatory event/issue › Operation in violation of license
definition: The operation was carried out while the operator had no Air Operator Certificate (AOC) or carried out the operation in violation of the conditions of the AOC.

name: ATS license invalid
path: Regulatory issues / events › Aircraft related regulatory event/issue › Operation in violation of license
definition: The Air Traffic Service provider had no license or carried out its operation in violation of the conditions of the license

name: Rest time related
path: Regulatory issues / events › Aircraft related regulatory event/issue
definition: Rest time related: an event related to the rest time of personnel

name: Rest time less than required by regulation
path: Regulatory issues / events › Aircraft related regulatory event/issue › Rest time related
definition: Rest time less than required by regulation

name: Staffing related event
path: Regulatory issues / events › Aircraft related regulatory event/issue
definition: An event involving the staffing of a workplace:

name: Crew/staff not licensed for activity
path: Regulatory issues / events › Aircraft related regulatory event/issue › Staffing related event
definition: Crew/staff did not possess valid licences for the activity undertaken

name: Staffing/crewing less than required
path: Regulatory issues / events › Aircraft related regulatory event/issue › Staffing related event
definition: There were fewer staff/crew members at the workplace than required by regulation.

name: An event other than those listed above
definition: A problem involving an event other than those listed above.

name: Unknown
definition: Something happened but the details are not known or insufficient to permit a more detailed classification.

name: Missing aircraft
path: Unknown
definition: The aircraft is considered missing when the official search has been terminated.
